title: Counting all matroids on ten elements
description:
Exact counting code, an algorithm note with pseudocode and correctness proofs, and reproducible results for all matroids on ten elements at every rank, including loops, parallel elements, coloops, and disconnected matroids.

The recorded totals are 3,232,000,741,644 unlabeled matroids and 11,727,995,799,397,397,461 labeled matroids. The validation guide includes published comparisons, rank totals, all 42 rank-five Burnside terms, and commands to reproduce and check the calculation.

Author: Sunghyeon Jo (GitHub: ainta). Fixed GitHub release; algorithm note (PDF); validation guide.
